breakdown.description: The solver `buoyantBoussinesqSimpleFoam` is designed for the Boussinesq approximation, but the thermophysical properties are set for a compressible `perfectGas` model.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the `buoyantBoussinesqSimpleFoam` solver requires a Boussinesq fluid model. It specified the appropriate `thermoType` settings (`type heRhoThermo; mixture Boussinesq; ... equationOfState Boussinesq;`) instead of the contradictory `perfectGas` model, thus resolving the inconsistency.
